kind: actual physical EFY PIN authentication via native ARM64 helper
retry_policy: no retry or fallback; NO_RETRY_WL and NO_GET_RESP APDU flags
pin_entry: user supplied through local NSSecureTextField; anonymous stdin pipe to helper; no chat/argv/file PIN

protocol.pin_transform: SHA1(raw ASCII PIN bytes) || BE32(raw byte count)
protocol.authentication: 3DES EDE3 CBC zero-IV encrypt 8-byte card challenge; external-auth 00 82 01 81 Lc8 via OpenSC secure messaging

cleanup.reset_policy: after any attempted user authentication, including uncertain transport failure

stdout_status_only:
PREFLIGHT PASS arm64; OpenSC 0.27.1; exact EFY ATR and certificate
AUTH SW=9000; no retry
PASS native ARM64 EFY PIN authentication
RESET rv=0
UNLOCK rv=0
DISCONNECT rv=0
user_auth_attempts=1; signatures=0

runtime.file: Mach-O 64-bit dynamically linked shared library arm64

scope: single observed EFY card profile only
no MSE/PSO/signature, no persistent card writes, no PIN change, no private key export
production Sources and app bundle untouched in this PIN-test step
limitations: PIN success proves challenge-auth route compatibility on this card; no claim that vendor C_Login takes the same internal branch.
No signature possession/verification, trust chain, revocation, or business-portal acceptance test.

Swift/AppKit may make transient managed-memory copies of field text; it is not a guarantee of process-wide zeroization. C PIN/key/challenge/cryptogram buffers and explicit Swift Data buffer cleared; core dumps disabled.
